actions.description: Invoke the acknowledged Kortex base/stop service; this reports the ROS callback result only, not a measured stopping position or zero velocity
actions.name: stop

outputs.description: True when the upstream ROS service callback returned true; this is not a stopped-state measurement
outputs.name: acknowledged

actions.description: Invoke the acknowledged Kortex base/apply_emergency_stop service; this reports the ROS callback result only and does not claim a physical emergency stop
actions.name: apply_emergency_stop

outputs.description: True when the upstream ROS service callback returned true; this is not a stopped-state measurement
outputs.name: acknowledged

device.name: Kinova Kortex ROS 1 base stop services

facts.text: BaseRobotServices advertises the relative ROS 1 service "base/stop" and binds it to BaseRobotServices::Stop.
BaseRobotServices advertises the relative ROS 1 service "base/apply_emergency_stop" and binds it to BaseRobotServices::ApplyEmergencyStop.
BaseRobotServices::Stop declares kortex_driver::Stop::Request and kortex_driver::Stop::Response parameters in the service callback signature.
BaseRobotServices::Stop calls m_base->Stop(m_current_device_id, m_api_options) and leaves the response message untouched.
BaseRobotServices::Stop catches Kinova::Api::KDetailedException and std::runtime_error, returns false in both handlers, and returns true after a successful call.
BaseRobotServices::ApplyEmergencyStop declares kortex_driver::ApplyEmergencyStop::Request and kortex_driver::ApplyEmergencyStop::Response parameters in the service callback signature.
BaseRobotServices::ApplyEmergencyStop calls m_base->ApplyEmergencyStop(m_current_device_id, m_api_options) and leaves the response message untouched.
BaseRobotServices::ApplyEmergencyStop catches Kinova::Api::KDetailedException and std::runtime_error, returns false in both handlers, and returns true after a successful call.
Stop.srv declares "Empty input" before the request separator and "Empty output" after it, so the generated request and response nest an Empty message under input and output.
ApplyEmergencyStop.srv declares "Empty input" before the request separator and "Empty output" after it, so the generated request and response nest an Empty message under input and output.
The generated interface header includes "kortex_driver/Stop.h", the generated header of the Stop service type.
The generated interface header includes "kortex_driver/ApplyEmergencyStop.h", the generated header of the ApplyEmergencyStop service type.

safe_state.description: The upstream ApplyEmergencyStop callback returned true; this is service acknowledgement only, not sensed zero velocity, not a physical emergency stop and not power isolation.
